definitions.gloss: marginal note; note in the side margin
definitions.explanation: An annotation placed in the side margin, beside the main text. Used to gloss individual words or explain the passage running alongside it, especially in annotated editions and textbooks.

examples.japanese: {傍注|ぼうちゅう}を{付|つ}ける。
{難|むずか}しい{語|ご}には{傍注|ぼうちゅう}がある。
{教科書|きょうかしょ}の{傍注|ぼうちゅう}を{頼|たよ}りに{原文|げんぶん}を{読|よ}み{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: Relying on the textbook's marginal notes, I worked my way through the original text.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {傍|ぼう} (side, beside) + {注|ちゅう} (note, annotation). Literally "a note at the side."

RELATED TERMS:
- {脚注|きゃくちゅう}: footnote — a note at the foot of the page
- {頭注|とうちゅう}: headnote — a note in the top margin
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}: annotation, commentary — the general term
